title: Varindi veBindu
intro: Mubindu rakasvibira, nharaunda yakaita mhiko huru. Asi kutsunga kwavo kwakaedzwa apo kuda kwaMwari kwakapindira, kuchishandura rupo rwavo kuita nyika isina chinhu.
clues: Takakomborerwa nebindu rakakura, asi takatanga kuzvikudza.
Asi patakasvika, takawana kuti bindu redu rakanga raparadzwa nehusiku humwe chete.
Takaona chikanganiso chedu ndokutanga kupomerana mhosva.
Takazopedzisira tapfidza, asi chidzidzo chakazodzidzwa kunonoka.
arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
